name: Jun Mizushima
source:
Jun Mizushima is the leader of one of the teams in the Young Developers' Club at his school. He's a huge fan of all things considered "geeky", including but not limited to comic books, sci-fi or fantasy stories, and video games.

He's the only child of two wealthy and prominent figures of the business world, who barely have any time for their son. Due to one incident that happened whne he was younger, Jun genuinely believes that he has special powers; one that allows him to grant any wish. But does he really?
